- Player character completely rebuild to replace marketplace based blueprint
- Inventory and item system completely rebuild
- Optimized lighting
- MegaLights lighting system utilized
- Major clean up and optimization of materials and textures
- Switch to substrate materials
- Common UI plugin activated and all menus rebuild for better gamepad support

- More consistent use of yellow as colour for objects with interaction
- Activated Electra plugin for better media playback support

MAGNITUDE OF THESE CHANGES WILL RESULT THE SAVE GAME FILES OF THE OLDER VERSION OF THE GAME TO STOP WORKING.

Known bugs.

- Use of Oxford commas is not consistent throughout the text files in the game.
